metadata.methodology: Flywheel-inspired HotpotQA/LoCoMo template over this project's markdown corpus. This is the decision pool: 50 HotpotQA-style multi-hop questions plus 20 LoCoMo-style multi-session trace questions.
metadata.name: K7 certification multi-hop retrieval cases
metadata.noise_floor_note: Treat deltas under 2 percentage points as noise. The case pool is curated for evidence-file recall, not answer judging.
